notes.en: Finds the server on the network without a typed address. Wi-Fi can be set from the web installer. The panel refresh is waited out in light sleep with Wi-Fi off, and timer wake-ups skip the button check: about half the battery use.
notes.zh-TW: 自動在網路上找到伺服器，不必輸入網址。可以在網頁安裝器設定 Wi-Fi。面板刷新期間關閉 Wi-Fi 並進入淺層睡眠，定時喚醒略過按鈕檢查：耗電約減半。

notes.en: Improv Serial identification: the web installer recognises the frame and updates it without erasing the settings.
notes.zh-TW: 支援 Improv Serial 識別：網頁安裝器可認出相框，升級時不清除設定。

notes.en: Status screens on the panel (setup with QR codes, errors, low battery), quiet retries with back-off instead of restart loops, faster wake-ups, wake-up telemetry in the server log.
notes.zh-TW: 面板狀態畫面（含 QR code 的設定畫面、錯誤、低電量）、失敗後退避重試取代重啟迴圈、更快的喚醒、伺服器記錄中的喚醒遙測。
